baseline_items.title: Tell us about yourself
baseline_items.instruction: Say your name, where you are from, what you study and why you chose Beauty and Cosmetology.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: Tell me your name, where you are from, what you study, and why you chose Beauty and Cosmetology.

baseline_items.title: Describe the salon picture
baseline_items.instruction: Look at the picture. Tell us what the stylist and customer are doing. If you cannot see it, describe how someone gets braids at a salon.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: Look at the salon picture. What is happening? If you cannot see it, describe how someone gets braids at a salon.

baseline_items.title: Explain your work
baseline_items.instruction: Explain how you make a wig or do another salon procedure you know.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: How do you make a wig, or do another salon procedure you know? Tell me the steps.

baseline_items.title: Listen to the customer
baseline_items.instruction: Listen to the customer. Then tell us what the customer wants and what you would ask next.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: Hello. I would like braids that are easy to maintain. I am not sure if I want them long or short. Can you help me choose?

baseline_items.title: Talk with a customer • 1 of 3
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: Hello. I am thinking about getting braids. Can you help me?

baseline_items.title: Talk with a customer • 2 of 3
baseline_items.instruction: Ask a useful question before recommending a style.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: I would like a style that is easy to care for. What would you ask me?

baseline_items.title: Talk with a customer • 3 of 3
baseline_items.instruction: Recommend a style and give a reason. Do not invent a price.
baseline_items.spoken_prompt: I would like something simple. What do you recommend, and why?

day5_challenge_items.title: Understand the customer
day5_challenge_items.instruction: Tell the customer what you understood. Ask what would help you choose.
day5_challenge_items.spoken_prompt: Hello. I want braids that are comfortable for work. I am not sure if I want them long or short. Can you help me?

day5_challenge_items.title: Welcome the customer
day5_challenge_items.instruction: Welcome the customer and help them begin.
day5_challenge_items.spoken_prompt: Hello. I am looking for a braid style. Can you help me choose?

day5_challenge_items.title: Ask a useful question
day5_challenge_items.instruction: Ask a question before you recommend a style.
day5_challenge_items.spoken_prompt: I need a style that is easy to care for at work. What would you like to ask me?

day5_challenge_items.title: Recommend and explain
day5_challenge_items.instruction: Recommend a style and give a reason. Do not invent a price.
day5_challenge_items.spoken_prompt: I prefer something simple and comfortable. What do you recommend, and why?

day5_challenge_items.title: Close politely
day5_challenge_items.instruction: Finish the conversation politely. Do not promise a booking or price.
day5_challenge_items.spoken_prompt: Thank you for your advice. What should I do next?

review_items.text: I chose this course because I enjoy helping people.

salon_scenarios.scenario_goal: Help a friendly customer explore braids and discuss price honestly.
salon_scenarios.customer_goal: The customer wants braids and asks how much they cost.
salon_scenarios.customer_opening: Hello. I'd like braids. How much would they cost?
learner_objectives: Ask what kind of braids they want.
Explain that the price depends on details and offer to check.
target_language: Welcome. How can I help you?
What kind of braids would you like?
Let me check the price for that style.
success_conditions: The learner asks about braid preferences.
The learner responds to price without inventing an amount.

salon_scenarios.scenario_goal: Welcome a customer and learn what they want for an event.
salon_scenarios.customer_goal: The customer wants a hairstyle for graduation but is unsure which style to choose.
salon_scenarios.customer_personality: Friendly, a little unsure, and happy to answer questions.
salon_scenarios.customer_opening: Hello. I need a hairstyle for graduation. Can you help me?
learner_objectives: Ask one follow-up question about their preference.
target_language: Welcome. How can I help you?
What kind of hairstyle would you like?
Would you like it long or short?
success_conditions: The learner asks about the customer's needs.
The learner asks a clarifying question.

salon_scenarios.scenario_goal: Guide a customer from greeting through a recommendation and polite close.
salon_scenarios.customer_goal: The customer wants a hairstyle that is easy to maintain and asks for a recommendation.
salon_scenarios.customer_personality: Friendly, curious, and open to suggestions.
salon_scenarios.customer_opening: Hello. I want a hairstyle that is easy to maintain. Can you help me?
learner_objectives: Ask about their needs and preferences.
Recommend a style and explain why.
target_language: Welcome. How can I help you?
What kind of style do you like?
I recommend braids because they are easy to maintain.
success_conditions: The learner asks about needs and preference.
The learner recommends a suitable style with a reason.

lessons.title: This Is Me
lessons.objective: Introduce yourself and say what you study.

conversation.opening: Hello! I'm Kora. Tell me your name and what you study.
conversation.goal: Introduce yourself, say what you study, and explain why you chose it.
success_conditions: Learner names Beauty & Cosmetology as their course.
Learner gives a reason for studying it.

prompts.instruction: Say why you chose your course.
prompts.example: I want to help people feel confident.

prompts.instruction: Tell us about yourself. Say your name, what you study and why.
prompts.example: My name is Ama. I study beauty and cosmetology. I want to help people feel confident.
prompts.hint: My name is… I study… I want to…

lessons.title: My Salon
lessons.objective: Name and describe common salon objects.
lessons.challenge: Name a salon object and explain what you use it for.

prompts.example: This is a comb. I use it to comb hair.
prompts.hint: This is a… I use it to…

prompts.example: This is shampoo. I use it to wash hair.
prompts.hint: This is… I use it to…

prompts.instruction: Choose one salon object. Say what it is and what you use it for.
prompts.example: This is a dryer. I use it to dry hair.
prompts.hint: This is a… I use it to…

lessons.title: Welcome a Customer
lessons.objective: Greet a customer and ask what they need.

prompts.instruction: Welcome a customer to your salon.
prompts.example: Welcome. How can I help you today?

prompts.instruction: Ask what hairstyle the customer wants.
Ask one more question about the customer's choice.
prompts.example: Would you like long or short braids?

lessons.title: Recommend
lessons.objective: Recommend a hairstyle and explain why.
lessons.challenge: Give a customer a recommendation and a reason.

prompts.instruction: Recommend a hairstyle that is easy to maintain.
prompts.example: I recommend braids because they are easy to maintain.

prompts.instruction: Give one reason for your choice.
prompts.example: I think braids are a good choice because they are easy to care for.

prompts.instruction: Tell the customer why one choice may suit them better.
prompts.example: This would be better because you want a style that is easy to maintain.

lessons.title: Salon Challenge
lessons.objective: Guide a customer through a salon conversation.
lessons.challenge: Greet a customer, discover their needs, ask questions, recommend, explain and close.

prompts.instruction: Start a conversation with your customer.
prompts.example: Welcome. How can I help you today?
prompts.hint: Greet your customer, then ask what they need.

prompts.instruction: Ask a question to learn what the customer wants.
prompts.example: What kind of braids would you like?

prompts.instruction: Recommend a style and give a reason.
prompts.example: I recommend braids because they are easy to maintain.
Thank you for visiting. Let me check the details for you.
